code:
SELECT xed.value('@timestamp', 'datetime2') AS creation_time,
  xed.query('.') AS deadlock_graph
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(target_data AS XML) AS TargetData
  FROM sys.dm_xe_session_targets st
  JOIN sys.dm_xe_sessions s ON s.address = st.event_session_address
  WHERE s.name = 'system_health' AND st.target_name = 'ring_buffer'
) AS Data
CROSS APPLY TargetData.nodes(
  'RingBufferTarget/event[@name="xml_deadlock_report"]') AS X(xed);
caption: system_health captures every deadlock — no setup required.
